summary: Fixed babel/messages/catalog.py so a locale catalog names its own team in Language-Team (not the POT placeholder), babel/messages/extract.py so every keyword spec matching an argument count applies (the all-counts entry and the exact-count entry, in that order), and babel/messages/jslexer.py so comments are yielded without changing division state and a lone slash that cannot start a regex becomes an operator; the ZZ-territory fallback in babel/dates.py was already present from another fixer and made all 124 dates tests pass. All 138 shard tests pass; the last full-suite run gave 6699 passed and 5 failed, the failures being a missing tzdata module (test_dates and test_support zoneinfo cases) and a setup.py init_catalog entry-point error in the venv (test_setuptools_commands), both environmental and outside this shard.
